We are happy to welcome four new members to the EIS Lab: **Raksmey Pahn** (PhD), and **Makweya Tobias**, **Shikha Kumari**, and **Daria Kolotikhina** (Master's). Their work spans battery health analytics, solar power forecasting, and IoT process mining.
